name: services/prgroups/descriptors_all
description: Get a list of all descriptors of primary groups.
brief_description: Get a list of all descriptors of primary groups.

arguments.name: fields
arguments.description: Selector of result fields you are interested in. The selector must contain subset of primary fields, which are described in the returns section of descriptor method.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns: A list of dictionaries describing descriptors (as returned by descriptor method).
